newsitem.title: USA: IDEX votes 3-for-2 split, dividend hike.
newsitem.headline: IDEX votes 3-for-2 split, dividend hike.

text.p: IDEX Corp said Thursday its board authorized a three-for-two stock split and an increase in the cash dividend. Its chairman, Donald Boyce, also said the company expects to report record results for 1996.

The split will be brought about in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend. The cash dividend on post-split shares has been set at $0.12 per common share per calendar quarter. This is the equivalent of $0.18 per share on the pre-split shares and represents a 12.5 percent increase in the cash dividend.
Both the stock and cash dividend will be paid on January 31, 1997, record January 15.

Boyce said the stock split and increase in cash dividend is an indication of the board's confidence in IDEX's outlook. "We expect to report record sales, net income and earnings per share in 1996, and we are very well positioned for the future," he noted in a statement.
IDEX manufactures proprietary fluid handling and industrial products.
